scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dichvuoi/api && npm run build -w @dichvuoi/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @dichvuoi/api && npm run lint -w @dichvuoi/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @dichvuoi/api && npm run typecheck -w @dichvuoi/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
